item.title: Opinion: I Played Mario Kart Tour Every Day For Seven Years, And What Am I Left With?

description.p: Chequered flag.On 24th September 2019, Nintendo launched Mario Kart Tour for mobile devices. This was Mario’s second outing in mobile gaming, following 2016’s Super Mario Run, which had an impressive initial reception but seemingly failed to generate much revenue (compared with other big mobile games, including Nintendo’s own Fire Emblem Heroes).Mario Kart Tour aimed to change that, built with mobile player expectations in mind, and ultimately proved more successful than Super Mario Run at the time. So it's ironic then that Mario Run is still getting updates while Tour will end service on Wednesday 30th September 2026.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Review: Voidjoy GA-10 Elite Extender For Switch Pro Controller - The Pros Don't Outweigh The (Mod) Cons

description.p: Voidco.With the price of consoles, controllers, games, groceries — everything — shooting up over the last few years, you're likely keen to save pennies where you can. It's one thing to push the boat out for a new Switch 2, but add-ons and accessories can stretch budgets to breaking point. Is a $90 / £75 Pro Controller 2 really an essential purchase when your old Switch 1 Pro Controller is working just fine?Justifying that sort of money (or more if you want that fancy new Zelda one) might be tough, but what if you could upgrade your old Pro Controller with back buttons and broader functionality, and throw some analogue triggers into the bargain? That's what JSAUX is proposing with the Voidjoy Elite Extender, an add-on which attempts to give your old Pro a glow-up into something resembling other premium pads.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Soulslike 'Fountains' Gets A Free Switch 2 Upgrade Pack One Week After Launch

description.p: 120fps + an exclusive "Gauntlet Mode".We're into the final week of September and the video games have been coming so thick and fast that it's hard to keep up. One such game — indie Soulslike Fountains — released just last week on 17th September, although perhaps missing out on day one wasn't such a bad thing in this case: a free Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack has appeared on the eShop which adds 120fps support. Larvely.With a top-down view and a pixel-art aesthetic reminiscent of Hyper Light Drifter, Fountains is the work of Canada-based solo dev John Pywell, who started development back in 2020 before a successful Kickstarter campaign in 2022.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Reddit Mod Ordered To Cough Up $4,500,000 To Nintendo In Long-Running Switch Piracy Case

description.p: Update: The 'Archbox' case finally comes to a close.Back in July, Nintendo dished out a handful of lawsuits in its continued clampdown on Switch piracy. Four months on, one of these legal claims has come back as another win for Nintendo after the defendant failed to plead or otherwise respond within the court's given time.The case in question was against James 'Archbox' Williams, the lead moderator of the r/SwitchPirates subreddit, who Nintendo accused of offering "massive libraries of pirated Nintendo Switch games" via several "pirate shops".Read the full article on nintendolife.com

description.p: 2028 can't come soon enough.Unicorn Overlord was one of our very favourite games of 2024, so you can imagine our excitement this morning when we found out that the game's director and former Vanillaware dev, Takafumi Noma, has unveiled his next project, and it looks expectedly stunning.Dawngazer is an action RPG from Noma's new fantasy-based studio, Ignisphere.
